mapper.sql: select cdrg_llave as llaveTabla ,cdrg_documentoprincipal as documentoPrincipal ,cdrg_documentomodificador as documentoModificador ,ddrg_fecha as fecha ,cdrg_estadoinicial as estadoInicial ,cdrg_estadofinal as estadoFinal ,cdrg_usuario as usuario ,cdrg_ubicacion as ubicacion ,cdrg_valores as valores ,(select mpvd_saldo from pedidoventadinero_pvdp where cpvd_llave = cdrg_valores) as saldo ,(select mpvd_valortotal from pedidoventadinero_pvdp where cpvd_llave = cdrg_valores) as total ,(select cpdv_transaccion from pedidoventa_pdvp where cpdv_llave = cdrg_documentomodificador) as transaccion ,ddrg_cierre as cierre ,cdrg_nombre as nombre ,cdrg_estado as estado from documentorelaciongestor_drgp a
mapper.select: update documentorelaciongestor_drgp set cdrg_documentoprincipal = #{documentoPrincipal}, cdrg_documentomodificador = #{documentoModificador}, ddrg_fecha = #{fecha}, cdrg_estadoinicial = #{estadoInicial}, cdrg_estadofinal = #{estadoFinal}, cdrg_usuario = #{usuario}, cdrg_ubicacion = #{ubicacion}, cdrg_valores = #{valores}, ddrg_cierre = #{cierre}, cdrg_nombre = #{nombre}, cdrg_estado =#{estado}
mapper.sql: select cdrg_llave as llaveTabla ,cdrg_documentoprincipal as documentoPrincipal ,cdrg_documentomodificador as documentoModificador ,ddrg_fecha as fecha ,cdrg_estadoinicial as estadoInicial ,cdrg_estadofinal as estadoFinal ,cdrg_usuario as usuario ,cdrg_ubicacion as ubicacion ,cdrg_valores as valores ,ddrg_cierre as cierre ,cdrg_nombre as nombre ,cdrg_estado as estado from documentorelaciongestor_drgp a
mapper.select: where ddrg_cierre is null and cdrg_estado = 'A' and cdrg_documentoprincipal = #{documentoPrincipal} order by ddrg_fecha desc limit 1
